scope: Same-assistant exact-span review. The public vote line is a common authored prefix. Full compound criteria require actor binding and material conditions. The Haiti duration criterion requires explicit offsets from adoption for both clocks. Tracked working ideas are a selected proposition inventory and carry source-specific attribution. Absence of a role label is recorded as an omission and cannot by itself establish a contrary role.
